uncertainty_notes: UNCERTAIN: pre-1993 feudal co-principality under the French head of state and the Bishop of Urgell; France conducted its foreign relations and its international sovereignty was contested. Became unambiguously sovereign with the 1993 constitution; joined UN 1993-07-28; US relations 1995. Treated as disputed rather than recognized_non_un; ISO AD assigned since 1974.
Admitted as Dahomey 1960; renamed Benin 1975. ISO code changed DY->BJ in 1977 (ISO 3166-3).
Bantustan declared independent 1977-12-06; recognized only by South Africa (and Transkei).
Named Upper Volta until 1984; ISO HV valid 1974-1984 (ISO 3166-3).

Original UN member (seat granted at Yalta as a USSR concession) but a constituent republic of the USSR, not an independent state; foreign and defence policy set by Moscow. Had its own ISO 3166 code because of UN membership (ISO 3166-3).

UN seat held by Democratic Kampuchea (Khmer Rouge) in Aug 1979 although the Vietnam-backed People's Republic of Kampuchea controlled Phnom Penh from 1979-01-07; US opposed PRK and did not recognize it.
Bokassa's Central African Empire (1976-12-04 to 1979-09-20); republic restored after the date. Same UN seat and ISO code.
Original member seat (1945) held by PRC since UNGA Res. 2758 (1971-10-25). US recognized PRC effective 1979-01-01.
Northern third under Turkish Cypriot administration since 1974 (see turkish_federated_state_of_kibris).
Original member; dissolved 1992-12-31. ISO CS valid 1974-1993.
ISO code changed AI (French Afars and Issas)->DJ in 1977 (ISO 3166-3).
East Germany; US established relations 1974. ISO DD valid 1974-1990.
Original member; seat held as United Arab Republic 1958-1971.
Macías Nguema overthrown by Obiang coup on 1979-08-03, three days before the date.
West Germany. Admitted 1973-09-18 alongside the GDR; the current 'Germany' UN membership continues the FRG's.
Vatican City State; permanent observer since 1964; never a member. US had a personal presidential envoy only; full relations 1984.
Withdrew 1965-01-20, resumed participation 1966-09-28; UN treats membership as continuous from 1950.

Independent 1979-07-12 (25 days before the date); joined UN 1999-09-14. UNCERTAIN: ISO 3166-3 lists Gilbert Islands GE as valid 1974-1979 then renamed KI; the exact 1979 date KI replaced GE is not confirmed, so on 1979-08-06 the published code may still have been GE.
Joined UN 1990-09-18; Swiss handled much of its foreign representation.
Renounced its Western Sahara claim in the Algiers agreement of 1979-08-05, one day before the date.
Joined UN 1993-05-28; foreign relations closely tied to France by 1918 treaty.
Independent 1968-01-31; Commonwealth special member; joined UN 1999-09-14.
UN observer; joined UN 1991-09-17. Not recognized by the US.
North Yemen. Admitted 1947 as Yemen; the current unified Yemen membership continues it.

Proclaimed by Polisario 1976-02-27; recognized by a number of mostly African and socialist states by 1979, not by the US. Western Sahara was contested by Morocco and (until the 1979-08-05 Algiers agreement) Mauritania; no sovereign widely recognized as holding it, so scoped_under is null. ISO EH is the territory code, not assigned to the SADR.
Independent 1979-02-22; admitted to UN 1979-09-18 (after the date).
Credentials rejected and delegation barred from UNGA participation since 1974, but membership not terminated.
UN observer; joined UN 1991-09-17. US ally.
South Yemen; no US diplomatic relations 1969-1990. ISO YD valid 1974-1990.
Original member; part of UAR 1958-1961, resumed separate membership 1961-10-13.

Held China's UN seat 1945-1971 until UNGA Res. 2758. US switched recognition to PRC effective 1979-01-01; Taiwan Relations Act 1979-04-10 keeps unofficial ties via AIT. Still recognized by ~20 states in 1979. ISO TW.
Tanganyika admitted 1961-12-14; Zanzibar admitted 1963-12-16; united 1964-04-26 as one member.
Bantustan declared independent 1976-10-26; recognized only by South Africa (UNGA Res. 31/6 A called it invalid).
Independent 1978-10-01; Commonwealth special member; joined UN 2000-09-05. TV code since the 1977 split from Gilbert and Ellice Islands.

Original UN member (seat granted at Yalta as a USSR concession) but a constituent republic of the USSR, not an independent state; foreign and defence policy set by Moscow. Had its own ISO 3166 code because of UN membership (ISO 3166-3).
Original member seat, continued by the Russian Federation in 1991. ISO SU valid 1974-1992 (ISO 3166-3).
Unified 1976-07-02; admitted 1977-09-20. North Vietnam code VD deleted 1977 (ISO 3166-3).

Proclaimed 1979-06-01 (successor to UDI Rhodesia, 1965); recognized by no state. UK regarded it as the Crown colony of Southern Rhodesia, restored direct rule 1979-12-12; Zimbabwe independent 1980-04-18. ISO RH (Southern Rhodesia) valid 1974-1980.
